# r/bostonceltics (post by hand; read the sub's self-promotion rules first)

**Title:** Where the Boston Celtics stand in The 644, our ranking of all 644 NBA players

**Body:**

The Boston Celtics in The 644, our ranking of every NBA player. The top eight by rank, with each player's GRAVITY score (50 is a league-average minute):

- #24 Jayson Tatum 62.4
- #41 Neemias Queta 58.8
- #44 Derrick White 58.3
- #51 Payton Pritchard 57.4
- #135 Paul George 48.2
- #142 Mitchell Robinson 47.6
- #144 Sam Hauser 47.6
- #192 Luka Garza 44.6

GRAVITY is our one-number player rating: how good, times how often. Every player has a free profile page, and the table filters by team: https://thegravityreport.com/the644/

Happy to answer questions about the method in the comments.

slides: Boston fell from 5th in July to 11th in our team model, and TORQUE took 1.4 points off its score. Still, four Celtics sit inside the top 51 of The 644, led by Tatum at #24.
Boston's TORQUE score fell from 52.9 in July to 51.4 now, and only four teams lost more. That's 11th of 30 in our team model, down from 5th, and a projection of 46.4 wins instead of 50.3.

Jayson Tatum's 62.4 is the best GRAVITY score on the Celtics, #24 of all 644 players and All-Star tier by our model. Neemias Queta is the second-best Celtic at #41 with 58.8; we wrote a Deep Dive on him.
